title: PackRight: Warehouse Order Packing
context: Fulfilment centres pack orders into boxes and trucks, deciding box contents and truck capacity under deadlines.
input: Items (weight, value); orders; truck capacities; dock bookings.

milestones.title: Pairs for a box
milestones.requirement: Count pairs of items whose weights sum exactly to a box limit (hash counting).

milestones.title: Best box fill
milestones.requirement: Best weight within a 15 kg box (subset DP).

milestones.title: Units in any hour range
milestones.requirement: Prefix sums over units packed per hour.

milestones.title: Fill a truck fastest
milestones.requirement: Fewest consecutive orders whose weight reaches a truck load (variable window).

milestones.title: Truck capacity
milestones.requirement: Least truck capacity to ship in-order orders within 3 days.
